title: Qlippy: A Retrieval-Augmented GenAI Assistant for Reproducible Quantum Workflows and Experiment Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2609.05039v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum software development is iterative and error-prone. Noisy hardware and repeated re-execution make experiment tracking, provenance, and reproducibility essential, yet these practices are hard to adopt because of tooling complexity and the specialized knowledge they demand. General-purpose language models can help but tend to hallucinate and lack grounding in domain-specific tooling. We present Qlippy, a retrieval-augmented GenAI assistant embedded in the development environment that grounds its responses in a curated corpus of quantum-software-engineering knowledge. Qlippy explains reproducibility and provenance concepts in context and augments existing Qiskit programs with MLflow-based experiment tracking aligned to the QProv schema. translated_title: Qlippy：面向可复现量子工作流与实验追踪的检索增强生成式AI助手
translated_abstract: 量子软件开发具有迭代性且容易出错。噪声硬件和反复的重复执行使得实验追踪、来源记录（provenance）和可复现性变得至关重要，然而由于工具的复杂性以及这些实践所需的专业知识，它们难以被广泛采用。通用大语言模型虽然能提供帮助，但往往会产生幻觉，且缺乏对特定领域工具的扎实理解。我们提出了Qlippy，一个嵌入开发环境的检索增强生成式AI助手，它将其响应建立在一个精心整理的量子软件工程知识语料库之上。Qlippy能在上下文中解释可复现性和来源记录的相关概念，并通过基于MLflow、符合QProv模式的实验追踪功能来增强现有的Qiskit程序。通过将知识与模型参数分离，这种基于检索的扎根方式使助手响应的范围和来源得到显式控制，并降低了对模型规模的依赖，这指向了……
tldr: Qlippy是一个嵌入开发环境的检索增强生成式AI助手，通过扎根于精选的量子软件工程知识语料库来解释可复现性与来源记录概念，并为Qiskit程序添加符合QProv模式的MLflow实验追踪，从而支持可复现的量子工作流。
en_tdlr: Qlippy is a retrieval-augmented GenAI assistant embedded in the development environment that grounds its responses in a curated quantum-software-engineering corpus and augments Qiskit programs with MLflow-based experiment tracking aligned to the QProv schema, enabling reproducible quantum workflows.
